entries.subject: Color
entries.finding: A black body at the 1,152 K dayside brightness temperature measured in secondary eclipse at 3.6 µm (Kammer et al. 2015, dayside brightness temperature at 3.6 µm (NASA Exoplanet Archive emission table)): #ff4900.
